description: File a free-form report on a project by hand: a bug you found yourself, a backlog item, or work for an agent. Pass title (3-200 chars) and description (up to 10000 chars: what happens, steps, what you expected, how to check it is fixed); severity (critical | high | medium | low) and component are optional hints that triage may refine. The report is stored with status new and goes through the same triage as a user report (classification, diagnosis), so it can then be dispatched with dispatch_fix. Returns { reportId, projectId, title, status, severity, component }. Write; not idempotent (a retry files a second report); at most 30 filed reports per project an hour; viewers cannot file. Use for work no user reported; for issues already in Sentry use import_sentry_issues. Then call triage_issue on the new reportId.

description.description: What happens, steps to reproduce, what you expected, and how to check it is fixed

projectId.description: Project UUID. Defaults to configured project. (`project_id` is accepted too.)

severity.description: Your severity hint; triage may refine it

name: file_report

reportId.description: The new report id; pass it to triage_issue or dispatch_fix

status.description: Always new: triage starts right away

title: File a report
